I answered Dana in her #north-team thread: the latest seat count for Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal is 261 seats. Ilse posted that number in the channel on Oct 14.

I didn't find a signed renewal document that confirms 261, so I suggested Dana check with Ilse before she puts it in the tracker. I also pointed out that 185 is the older count, from Amendment No. 1 in August 2025.
